source_and_schedule_findings: Actual backend compiles fresh locked V1.4 C++ copies; SAR and DFF initialized/executed, Adder dimensions/capacitances and formula.h methods supply the explicit gate DAG. Whole-Adder diagnostics are not substituted for the full path.

Held SAR code, input-bit index, output-group select and old accumulator launch at E0. E1 only changes phase; existing output bank write disabled at E1, capture at E2. No new intermediate storage or conversion overlap. Control counters, IO, clear, verify-done and E1-to-E2 capture-enable retain one-cycle constraints.

Fixed normalization and plane weighting are wires. Common9/11/15/23bit topology is numerically equivalent to declared signed encoding. Same compiled graph independently checked with random legal counts/ibit/23bit previous accumulator; constant-output NAND gates retain both input pin loads and installed gate counts match for both count domains.

All timing minima independently recomputed as max(pathdelay/availablecycles). Misclassifying reconstruction as onecycle makes5ns fail; assigning two cycles to captureenable/control is rejected by production tests. Main nominal5ns policy is legal, not a global service optimum.

Independent closed-form serial-service formulas and every trace/stage ledger match main,5.25,5.5,wire and physical-service dependency points. Each operating point reports rho and tau from its own full streaming/resident schedule; no spliced optima. SRAM public write port and RRAM4096controlticks/rail/publication all follow sameperiod.

RRAM20ns windows remain independent ofSAR, railsetup/exit once per matrix, bounded1024RESET/512SET/1536verify counts retained, finitefailure semantics unchanged. Aggregate writeLatency remainsnull. At5ns final publication costs5ns relative to legacy sum, givingTR1911765ns.
V1 result/report files and Step2 ten case inputs retained byte-for-byte; no siblingNVM/TableII/paper/upstream writes by reviewer.
